title: Control the grace clock in named-root late-event completion test
outcome: named_root_late_event_survives_actual_observation_close verifies late-event attribution after actual close without racing 750 ms of host time.
acceptance: The test drives actual observation close and late event acceptance with a controlled grace clock or equivalent deterministic admission boundary, retaining the exact owner/path and one-summary assertions.
The 750 ms production grace and event attribution semantics remain unchanged; no timeout inflation, retry or ignore is added.
